assets.research_label: Research only — not approved for live trading

research_basis.diagnostic_source: Kraken Q1 2026 trade data aggregated to 4-hour candles
research_basis.candidate_amendment: Low-regime EMA50 one-candle slope must be at least -0.02%
research_basis.note: KuCoin forward results are kept separate from Kraken research and are not merged into one P&L series.

research_experiments.manual_approval_note: The highest-ranked post-hoc candidate is a research hypothesis only. Manual approval and a new forward-test start date are required before independent validation.

hypotheses.name: Structural Price Filter
hypotheses.hypothesis: Require the problem-regime entry price to be at or above EMA200.
hypotheses.human_rule: entry requires close at or above EMA200

hypotheses.name: Long-Trend Slope Filter
hypotheses.hypothesis: Require EMA200 to be flat or rising before a problem-regime entry.
hypotheses.human_rule: entry requires EMA200 slope at least 0% per candle

hypotheses.name: ATR Contraction Filter
hypotheses.hypothesis: Avoid entries while short-term volatility is expanding.
hypotheses.human_rule: entry requires ATR(14) no higher than its level 24 hours earlier

hypotheses.name: Bearish Sequence Filter
hypotheses.hypothesis: Avoid entries after three or more consecutive bearish candles.
hypotheses.human_rule: entry allows at most two consecutive bearish candles

hypotheses.name: EMA50 Recovery Filter
hypotheses.hypothesis: Require price to recover to EMA50 before entering the problem regime.
hypotheses.human_rule: entry requires close at or above EMA50

principles: Production strategies are immutable
One-variable evidence comes before combinations
Post-hoc results are suggestions, not validation
Every promotion requires a new forward-test start date
strategy_evolution.suggestion_note: Suggestions are generated automatically, but no strategy or setting is changed without manual approval.

app.name: Crypto Regime Manager
app.mode: TEL/TAO advisory + SUI research + immutable candidate registry
app.note: V18 consolidates the operator experience, adds a unified workspace and a safe KuCoin historical-data manager while preserving V17 trading and validation logic.

threecommas.note: Read-only BOTS_READ via RSA. Masked hides exact prices and dollar amounts because GitHub Pages is public.

health_monitor.note: Health score is a monitoring indicator, not a forecast or probability of profit.

trading_intelligence.note: Opportunity scores apply only to production assets. Research assets are excluded until promotion gates pass and promotion is approved manually.

principles: Cross-asset tests are diagnostic evidence, not permission to change production strategies
Every asset keeps its own frozen baseline settings
The transferred rule is applied to the same named regime only
A rule must improve more than one asset before it can be described as generalisable
No production strategy is changed automatically
cross_asset_evidence.note: The evidence library compares suggested rules across TEL, TAO, and SUI. Results use each asset’s available KuCoin history and are not independent forward validation.

principles: Asset DNA records how each tested rule affects each asset; it does not alter production settings
Scores combine profit, drawdown, duration, and deal-count effects relative to the frozen baseline
A small evidence set is labelled low confidence
Similar assets are suggestions for future research, not proof that settings transfer
Every live amendment still requires an asset-specific forward test and manual approval
asset_dna.note: Asset DNA is a compact research profile built from the evidence library. It grows as more distinct hypotheses and assets are tested.

Volatility State.label: ATR no higher than 24 hours earlier

Candle Structure.label: No more than two bearish candles

principles: Traits summarise observed rule responses; they are not permanent facts about an asset
Context labels require multiple distinct tests before confidence can rise
Pending branches are research suggestions, not active strategy rules
Production strategies remain immutable without manual approval and a new forward test
context_traits.note: The Context & Trait Engine organises evidence by asset, market regime, and hypothesis family. It proposes the next research branch but never changes a live strategy.

experiments.title: EMA100 Recovery
experiments.human_rule: entry requires close at or above EMA100
experiments.description: Tests an intermediate structural trend threshold between EMA50 and EMA200.

experiments.title: EMA200 1% Buffer
experiments.human_rule: entry requires close at least 1% above EMA200
experiments.description: Tests whether a safety buffer above the long-term trend improves robustness.

experiments.title: EMA200 Rising 24h
experiments.human_rule: entry requires EMA200 to be flat or rising over 24 hours
experiments.description: Tests long-term trend direction rather than only price location.

experiments.title: ATR Percentile Cap
experiments.human_rule: entry requires ATR percentile at or below 60
experiments.description: Avoids entries during unusually elevated volatility.

experiments.title: Bullish Recovery Candle
experiments.human_rule: entry requires a bullish completed candle
experiments.description: Requires immediate price-action confirmation before entry.

experiments.title: RSI Recovery
experiments.human_rule: entry requires RSI to rise versus the prior candle
experiments.description: Requires momentum to begin recovering before entry.

experiments.title: MACD Histogram Improvement
experiments.human_rule: entry requires an improving MACD histogram
experiments.description: Tests whether improving momentum reduces premature entries.

automatic_research_pipeline.note: V12 executes the full diagnostic queue automatically and publishes ranked results. Automatic execution does not authorise production changes.

Trend Confirmation.title: EMA200 0.5% Buffer
Trend Confirmation.human_rule: entry requires close at least 0.5% above EMA200

Trend Confirmation.title: EMA150 Recovery
Trend Confirmation.human_rule: entry requires close at or above EMA150

Trend Confirmation.title: EMA200 1.5% Buffer
Trend Confirmation.human_rule: entry requires close at least 1.5% above EMA200

Trend Confirmation.title: EMA100 Rising 24h
Trend Confirmation.human_rule: entry requires EMA100 flat or rising over 24 hours

Trend Confirmation.title: EMA200 2% Buffer
Trend Confirmation.human_rule: entry requires close at least 2% above EMA200

Momentum Confirmation.title: RSI Two-Candle Recovery
Momentum Confirmation.human_rule: entry requires RSI to rise for two completed candles

Volatility State.title: ATR Percentile 50 Cap
Volatility State.human_rule: entry requires ATR percentile at or below 50

autonomous_research_evolution.note: The engine chooses and runs diagnostic experiments automatically, but all bot, entry, exit and DCA recommendations remain advisory until a frozen forward test passes and the user approves the change.

principles: Candidates are immutable after freezing
A new rule creates a new candidate version instead of overwriting an earlier candidate
Forward evidence begins only after the candidate was frozen
Candidate registration never changes a production strategy
Promotion, bot control, DCA changes and live execution require later validated stages and explicit approval
candidate_intelligence.note: V14 turns autonomous research winners into permanent, versioned candidate records. It registers and freezes evidence but does not yet evaluate the candidate on post-freeze candles.

nominated_candidate.name: SUI T1 Trend Candidate

amendment.human_rule: Medium entry requires close at least 0.5% above EMA200

nominated_candidate.reason: Manually accepted V13 winner for immutable registration and future forward testing.

forward_validation_manager.note: Frozen candidates are replayed against the unchanged baseline using only post-freeze entries. Passing gates permits manual paper-trading review, never live execution.

advisory_decision_preview.note: Decision previews are shown only after forward gates pass. DCA and exit settings remain unchanged and live execution is disabled.

principles: Production and research assets remain clearly separated
Every recommendation includes its blockers and next manual action
Data freshness and strategy health can veto a review-ready label
Forward-validation evidence is never mixed with historical diagnostic evidence
No page can authorise live execution or change DCA or exit settings
operational_intelligence.note: V17 consolidates portfolio posture, prioritised alerts and compact asset actions into a read-only operator cockpit.
